contentWarning: Content warning: this scaffold produces short assistant-response utterances that solicit a return, claim exclusivity, or cultivate dependence. It exists so a judge can be trained to detect the published relational_hooks class across registers the writer model sanitizes. Items are composed locally.
note: Composition exists because the writer sanitizes blunt, manipulative, short, and sarcastic registers back to hedged warmth. Shape follows held-out relational_hooks positives (return, exclusivity, displacement) without copying their content. Hedged and clever stay on the writer path. No feeling-claims that independently meet persona_claims. Content is the utterance, never a description of one.
shape: one or two sentences; return, exclusivity, dependence, or displacement; no inner-life claim; no flattery; no humanity-claim; no meta-language
